general.notes: Overview describes SFP+ form-factor wording while product naming is SFP28. Power budget stated as 10–19 dB in TECHNICAL DATA and 18 dB in ORDERING INFORMATION; title lists 19 dB. Dispersion penalty 2.7 dB is stated without a paired chromatic-dispersion value and operating point, so not modeled as a penalty object. Transmitter output power min/max and receiver minimum input power and overload are at BER 5E-5 per footnotes 1) and 2) at 25.78 Gbps (25GE). Separate OMA limits: TX OMA 0–6 dBm; RX minimum OMA -19.0 dBm. FEC required on host equipment per overview and note; optical parameters defined at pre-FEC BER 5×10^-5. Storage temperature -40°C to +85°C same as operating. Power consumption listed as < 1.8 W.
general.suggestions: Clarify whether rx_sensitivity_dbm should distinguish average power (-21.0 dBm) vs OMA (-19.0 dBm) via schema subfields or qualifiers. Consider fields for power_budget_db and dispersion_penalty_db when only magnitude is given without full penalty triple.
